title: Gold Rate Today August 6: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices up in India | Photo Credit: K K Mustafah

Gold prices in India rose today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also increased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹13,775 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹265) and ₹1,10,200 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹2,120).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹13,775 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹265) and ₹1,10,200 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹2,120).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,464 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹275) and ₹1,15,712 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹2,224).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Chennai today were ₹13,450 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹270) and ₹1,10,000 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹2,160).

The gold prices in Delhi today were ₹14,516 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (up by ₹278) and ₹1,16,128 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (up by ₹2,224).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Ahmedabad today were ₹13,829for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (up by ₹265) and ₹1,07,792 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (up by ₹680).
